modbus.title: Modbus TCP (read-only)
modbus.description: Only one TCP client can use the Smart Connect. Do not use this alongside an EV charger or another Modbus client. Enter the serial exactly as printed on the label. No firmware changes or device writes are performed.

data_description.serial: Use the device label serial, not the meter number. It is the stable device identity and cannot be changed in reconfiguration.
data_description.scan_interval: Default 10 seconds; range 5–3600 seconds. DSMR 4.2 updates every 10 seconds.
data_description.phase_count: Choose 1 or 3 explicitly. DSMR 4.2 reports zero voltage, which does not indicate the number of phases.
data_description.profile: Basic: 10 documented V1.6 power/current/voltage values, no energy. Extended: 49 documented V1.8 values including energy. Unsupported optional addresses are skipped until reload. No automatic profile or firmware changes.
data_description.energy_unit: Explicit choice: Wh for firmware V5.1.x or newer; kWh for older firmware (manual V1.8 footnote). Check your firmware; never infer from value magnitude. Only applies to energy in the extended map.

data_description.base_topic: Enter the topic through the Smart Connect serial number, for example: devices/my-site/smart-connect/ABC123. Do not include /data/power_instant.
Update the topic through the same Smart Connect serial number. For example: devices/my-site/smart-connect/ABC123. Do not include /data/power_instant.

discovery_confirm.description: Do you want to add the Xemex Smart Connect with serial number {serial}? It was discovered from its MQTT measurements.

error.invalid_value: Enter a valid integer, not a boolean.
error.invalid_host: Enter an IP address or hostname, without a URL, spaces or port.
error.invalid_serial: Copy the serial from the label; use letters, numbers, dot, hyphen or underscore only (maximum 64 characters).
error.cannot_connect: Could not read the Smart Connect. Check the endpoint and whether another client is already connected.
error.empty_base_topic: Enter the Xemex MQTT base topic.
error.invalid_base_topic: Use exactly devices/<site>/smart-connect/<serial>. Check that the site and serial number do not contain extra path segments.
error.measurement_topic_included: Remove /data/power_instant. Enter only the topic through the Smart Connect serial number.
error.mqtt_not_configured: The Home Assistant MQTT integration is not configured or enabled. Set it up first in Settings > Devices & services.
error.mqtt_not_connected: Home Assistant's MQTT integration is configured but is not connected to its broker. Restore the broker connection and try again.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: The serial must match the existing device. Add a separate device for a different serial.
abort.already_configured: This Xemex Smart Connect device is already configured.
abort.invalid_discovery_payload: The discovered MQTT message is not a valid Xemex measurement payload.
abort.invalid_discovery_topic: The discovered MQTT topic is not a valid Xemex Smart Connect measurement topic.
